test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 9 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. You have to consider these statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts. Decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the given statement.

**Statements:**

All sofas are chairs

All chairs are benches

All benches are desks

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some desks are sofas

(II) All chairs are sofas

(III) No chair is a sofa

options.text: Only conclusion I and III follows

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a7d38980de94d5763db1900f6ec241e655f8403ebc74ada27da6fef1c68e232.png] 

(I) Some desks are sofas → Follows ( it's definite that some desks are sofas, hence follows)
